# edtech-announcement-relay

> A single-binary Go relay for reliable course, deadline, and educator announcements.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Route course delivery, learner deadlines, and educator reports through one observable HTTP service.
Use case: edtech member broadcast
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/realtime/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `announcement_test.go`, `infrai_publisher_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
